bank-account.title: Opening a Bank Account
bank-account.summary: Visit a bank branch or an authorised Bank Mitra to open a basic savings account. Ask for account terms, KYC requirements, and charges in writing.
bank-account.whoItHelps: Anyone wanting a safe place to keep money and receive payments.
steps: Visit a nearby bank branch or authorised Bank Mitra in person.
Ask about basic savings account types and official options such as PMJDY.
Inquire which KYC documents are currently accepted for identity and address proof.
Confirm all account features, transaction limits, and applicable charges.
Obtain full written details, terms, and an acknowledgement before depositing money.
questions: What is the exact name and type of this savings account?
Which KYC documents do I need to submit to complete verification?
Are there minimum amount requirements or maintenance fees?
Does this account provide a passbook, ATM card, or mobile banking access?
bank-account.caution: PMJDY is an official scheme option to ask about, not a guaranteed entitlement. All account openings, fees, and rules are determined by the bank under current official regulations.

digital-payments.title: Safe Digital Payments & UPI
digital-payments.summary: UPI lets you pay directly from your bank account using a mobile phone. Learn how to pay safely and protect your secret security codes.
digital-payments.whoItHelps: Anyone using a smartphone to send or receive money electronically.
steps: Link your registered mobile number to your bank account using an official UPI app.
Set a secret personal UPI PIN that you remember and never disclose to anyone.
Enter your UPI PIN only when you are sending money or paying a bill.
Always verify the recipient name displayed on the screen before confirming payment.
Never scan unfamiliar QR codes or click unexpected reward or refund links.
questions: How can I instantly disable UPI payments if my phone is lost or stolen?
Where can I review official transaction history inside my banking app?
What is the formal procedure to dispute a failed or incorrect payment?
digital-payments.caution: Never share your UPI PIN or OTP with anyone, including bank staff. Your PIN is required only to make a payment, never to receive money. Do not install unknown screen-sharing apps or click unverified links.

borrowing.title: Understanding Loans & Credit
borrowing.summary: Before taking a loan, understand the lender, principal, interest rate, fees, tenure, EMI, total repayment, late fees, and collateral.
borrowing.whoItHelps: Anyone planning to take a formal loan for business, agricultural, or personal needs.
steps: Understand key terms: lender (provider), principal (amount borrowed), and tenure (loan duration).
Review your EMI (monthly payment), interest rate, and total repayment amount over the full tenure.
Check that the lender is an RBI-authorised bank or registered financial company.
Ask for a detailed written breakdown of all processing fees, insurance charges, and late penalty terms.
Compare total borrowing costs across multiple authorised providers before signing any contract.
questions: Is your institution directly registered and authorised by the RBI?
What is the complete repayment amount including all interest, fees, and taxes?
What specific penalty charges apply if an EMI payment is delayed?
Is collateral required, and what are the exact conditions for early repayment?
borrowing.caution: Never pay an advance fee or commission to any agent promising guaranteed approval. Always verify lender authorisation with official sources and compare total costs in writing.

savings-protection.title: Savings, Insurance & Pensions
savings-protection.summary: Protect your household against unexpected life events with savings, insurance for emergency support, and pensions for regular retirement income.
savings-protection.whoItHelps: Individuals and families seeking long-term financial security and protection.
steps: Build an emergency reserve in an authorised bank account for urgent needs.
Understand insurance as protection that provides financial assistance upon specified illness or loss.
Understand pension schemes as structured plans that deliver regular income in retirement.
Visit your bank to ask about government-backed protection options such as Jan Suraksha schemes.
questions: What official government-backed insurance or pension schemes are offered at this branch?
What is the formal claim process and what documents are required for my nominee?
How are contribution payments scheduled and deducted from my savings account?
savings-protection.caution: Ask your bank or consult the official Jan Suraksha portal for current eligibility criteria, terms, and contribution rules. Ensure nominee details are accurately registered in writing.

help.title: Emergency Help & Fraud
help.summary: Immediate actions to take if you suspect fraud, sent money to the wrong person, or shared confidential banking details.
help.whoItHelps: Anyone who has encountered financial fraud, suspicious messages, or lost access to their account.
steps: Contact your bank or payment app immediately to freeze your account and debit card.
Call the national cyber helpline on 1930 to report the incident immediately.
Submit an official complaint on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal at cybercrime.gov.in.
Preserve all transaction records, SMS notices, screenshots, and caller numbers as evidence.
questions: Can you block my digital services right now to prevent further transactions?
What is the formal reference number for this incident report?
What is the official procedure and timeline for resolving this dispute?
help.caution: Never disclose your OTP, passwords, or UPI PIN to anyone, even callers claiming to be police officers or bank investigators. Official agencies will never ask for your PIN to resolve a complaint.

banking.title: Basic Banking
banking.summary: A bank account keeps money safe and enables official transactions.
paragraphs: A bank account keeps your money safe in an official place.
KYC means Know Your Customer, where the bank confirms your identity with official documents.
A Bank Mitra is a trusted banking helper who provides basic bank services in your village or neighbourhood.
You can deposit money, withdraw cash, and check your passbook at any time.
Ask your local bank branch or Bank Mitra to learn current terms and services.
takeaways: KYC confirms your identity with official documents.
A Bank Mitra helps you access banking services nearby.
Always get an official receipt for any deposit or withdrawal.
Verify current account options with your bank.

savings.title: Savings Habits
savings.summary: Regular saving creates a protective safety net for emergencies and future plans.
paragraphs: Saving even small amounts regularly builds security for unexpected needs.
Money kept in a bank account stays protected and separate from daily spending.
Setting a clear purpose helps you stay focused on your saving habit.
Small regular deposits grow over time into a helpful fund.
Official savings schemes offer different benefits, so ask your bank for details.
takeaways: Regular small savings protect against sudden expenses.
Keep your savings in an official bank account.
Define a purpose to stay on track.
Check current official savings options with your bank.

upi.title: UPI & Digital Payments
upi.summary: UPI lets you send money quickly from your bank account using a phone.
paragraphs: UPI is Unified Payments Interface, an official system for quick bank transfers.
You can send money directly using a phone number or a QR code.
A UPI PIN is your secret security number known only to you.
You only enter your UPI PIN to send money, never to receive money.
Scan codes only from verified merchants and trusted people.
takeaways: UPI transfers money directly between bank accounts.
Your UPI PIN is required only to send money.
Never enter your UPI PIN or scan a QR code to receive money.
Always verify the receiver name before confirming payment.

fraud.title: Digital Fraud Prevention
fraud.summary: Protect yourself from scams by keeping your secret codes private.
paragraphs: Frauds happen when someone tricks you into giving away secret information.
An OTP is a One-Time Password sent to your phone to authorize actions.
Bank staff and police will never ask for your UPI PIN, OTP, or password.
Never install screen-sharing apps or click unknown links from messages.
If someone pressures you to act quickly, pause and verify with your bank.
takeaways: Never share your UPI PIN, OTP, or passwords with anyone.
No official person will ever ask for secret codes.
Do not download apps or click links suggested by unknown callers.
Pause and consult your branch if an offer sounds suspicious.

borrowing.title: Borrowing & Interest
borrowing.summary: Understand loans, interest cost, and monthly repayments before taking debt.
paragraphs: A loan is money you borrow from an official lender and must pay back.
Interest is the extra cost charged by the lender for using their money.
An EMI is Equated Monthly Instalment, the fixed amount you repay each month.
Borrow only what you can comfortably repay alongside your living expenses.
Ask the lender for a complete cost summary before signing any loan agreement.
takeaways: Interest is the cost of borrowing money.
An EMI is the fixed monthly payment towards your loan.
Compare loan terms from official banks before deciding.
Borrow only what fits within your monthly budget.

help.title: Complaints & Seeking Help
help.summary: Know the official steps to report fraud and resolve banking disputes.
paragraphs: If you face an unauthorized transaction, contact your bank immediately.
Call the national cybercrime helpline at 1930 without delay for fraud.
Keep all transaction SMS messages and receipts as proof.
If your bank does not resolve your complaint, you can reach the RBI Ombudsman.
Official complaints are always registered through recognized government portals.
takeaways: Notify your bank immediately if any issue occurs.
Dial 1930 promptly to report financial cyber fraud.
Preserve SMS alerts and transaction records as evidence.
Use official complaint channels such as the RBI Ombudsman.

core.title: Financial Literacy Quiz
core.description: Test your knowledge on safe banking, UPI, loans, and scam prevention.

q1.question: Can anyone, such as bank staff or police, ask for your UPI PIN or OTP?
options: Yes, if they say they are bank staff or police
No, never share your UPI PIN or OTP with anyone
Yes, to receive a cash prize or refund into your account
q1.explanation: Your UPI PIN and OTP are strictly private. Legitimate bank staff, police, and government officials never ask for them.

q2.question: When is your UPI PIN required?
options: Only when sending money from your account
Every time someone sends money to your account
To check lucky draw prizes or scan incoming requests
q2.explanation: A UPI PIN is used only to authorize money leaving your account. You never need a PIN to receive money.

q3.question: What does KYC mean in a bank?
options: Know Your Customer, confirming identity with official documents
A private contract for lottery winnings
q3.explanation: KYC stands for Know Your Customer, where the bank verifies your identity using official government documents.

q4.question: What is an EMI when you repay a loan?
options: An unexpected penalty fee from the lender
Equated Monthly Instalment, the fixed repayment amount each month
q4.explanation: An EMI is the fixed monthly instalment you pay to repay your loan principal and interest over time.

q5.question: What should you do first if you suspect financial fraud on your phone?
options: Immediately contact your bank and call 1930
Wait for a few days to see if the money returns
Share your OTP with the caller to reverse the transfer
q5.explanation: Acting promptly by notifying your bank and calling the national cyber helpline 1930 gives the best chance to freeze unauthorized transfers.
